summary: A clean no can save you from the resentment you create by saying yes and punishing everyone for it later.
body: A clean no can save you from the resentment you create by saying yes and punishing everyone for it later. When Mars sextiles Lilith, you may have a direct chance to act on something you already know you do not want: decline the extra work, correct the assumption, change the plan, leave the obligation you never agreed to, or pursue the option you kept postponing because somebody might disapprove. The action does not have to be dramatic. The point is to stop making other people pay for a boundary you refused to state when you still had the chance.
